summary: Corrected the account's restart claim after checking NewRaft's initialisation: it restores the in-memory last log from the log store's last entry, so a restart clears the stale index only while the store's last index is still below the deleted suffix - once an entry has been stored above the gap, as the accepted append in the latest receipt does, the restart restores a last index above the hole and the conflict loop, which only reads the store at or below that index, never looks into it. Added the anchor (api.go 590-600), a fact knowledge entry contrasting the two restart outcomes with its conditions, and rewrote the third counterevidence item plus one limitation; the account otherwise stands. Validation returned valid with those effects and no execution requested; the hole-across-restart claim and the leader's use of the peer's match index remain source-read rather than measured.
